import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

# Parse all cells (row, col_letter -> value)
data = {}
for row in root.iter('{%s}row' % NS):
    for c in row.iter('{%s}c' % NS):
        ref = c.get('r')
        t = c.get('t')
        v = c.find('{%s}v' % NS)
        is_ = c.find('{%s}is' % NS)
        if t == 'inlineStr' and is_ is not None:
            val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_.iter('{%s}t' % NS))
        elif v is not None:
            val = v.text
        else:
            continue
        data[ref] = val

# Expenses: rows 11-22, column C amounts, grouped by category in column A
expenses = []
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = data.get(f'A{r}', '')
    item = data.get(f'B{r}', '')
    amt = float(data.get(f'C{r}', 0))
    expenses.append((cat, item, amt))

total = sum(e[2] for e in expenses)
print('Per-item expenses:')
for cat, item, amt in expenses:
    print(f'  {cat:<16} {item:<18} {amt:>10,.2f}')
print(f'TOTAL EXPENSES (all categories): {total:,.2f}')

# Per-category subtotals
from collections import OrderedDict
cats = OrderedDict()
for cat, item, amt in expenses:
    cats.setdefault(cat, 0.0)
    cats[cat] += amt
print('\nPer-category subtotals:')
for cat, amt in cats.items():
    print(f'  {cat:<16} {amt:>10,.2f}')
print(f'  {"TOTAL":<16} {sum(cats.values()):>10,.2f}')
EOF
